title: Rollback Approval Binding record
description: Phase 149L implementation of RAE-001 v1.0 (`docs/contracts/ROLLBACK_APPROVAL_EVIDENCE_CONTRACT.md`) Sec.8's frozen field table. A rollback_approval_binding document structurally binds exactly one published rollback-approval Decision (a human_governance_record referenced by governance_record_reference) to exactly one concrete Rollback Operation (AG3 or AG5). It is a new, dedicated record type -- not a CHGR-001 record family, not stored under schema_resources/chgr/**, and not a Typed Authority Model human_authorization artifact (RAE-REQ-003, RAE-REQ-016); record_type below is the independent, dedicated name this contract requires. Schema validity alone never establishes canonical provenance, trust, or authority -- that is exclusively the Evidence Validator's own two-check mechanism (content_digest recomputation plus governance_record_reference resolution against real CHGR storage, RAE-REQ-018/RAE-REQ-055). This is a mechanical conformance check for external inspection tooling, independent of, and never a substitute for, `rollback_approval_evidence.py`'s own runtime dataclass validation.

record_type.description: Always present. Fixed, dedicated family tag -- independent of, never equal to, any Typed Authority Model record_family value (RAE-REQ-003).

evidence_id.description: Always present. Stable identity of this Binding record for its lifetime, assigned only at creation (RAE-REQ-017). Never itself establishes authority.

governance_record_reference.description: Always present. Family-locked reference to the specific published rollback-approval Decision this evidence anchors to (RAE-REQ-018).

rollback_site.description: Always present. Which rollback mechanism this evidence targets (RAE-001 Sec.8).

rollback_operation_reference.description: Always present. Family-locked, per rollback_site, per RAE-REQ-022's discriminated-union rule; a mismatched shape is a schema-validation failure.

task_id.description: Conditionally meaningful: present (non-null) iff the Rollback Operation is task-scoped at approval time (RAE-REQ-030); null when no active governed task existed at approval time. Always present as a key, never omitted.

repository_state_binding.description: Always present. Repository state captured at approval time (RAE-REQ-033) -- distinct from RWMPC's own live, execution-time freshness re-check.

state.description: Always present. Written once at creation as 'issued' and never rewritten in place; the *effective* state is computed at resolution time from this field plus revocation-record existence, use_binding presence, and TTL comparison (149L implementation, structural precedent RAE-REQ-003).

decision.description: Always present. Denormalized from governance_record_reference's selected_option_id; the referenced Decision record remains the sole authoritative source (RAE-001 Sec.8).

replay_binding.description: Always present. Opaque one-time-use token reference (RAE-REQ-050) -- never a secret or token value itself.

revocation_metadata.description: Conditionally present: a revocation_metadata object iff state is 'revoked', null otherwise (RAE-001 Sec.8 row, enforced below).

use_binding.description: Conditionally present: a non-null opaque outcome-record reference iff state is 'used', null otherwise (RAE-REQ-050, enforced below).

content_digest.description: Always present. This Binding record's own content-integrity digest, computed over its canonical bytes with this field excluded (RAE-REQ-055). Shape-checked only; never recomputed at this schema layer -- recomputation is the Evidence Validator's own runtime responsibility.

timestamp.description: RFC3339 UTC, Z-suffixed, matching CHGR's own chgr_timestamp normalization convention (reused for consistency only, not imported).

digest.description: Bare 64-character lowercase hex SHA-256, mirroring schema_resources/chgr/shared/digest.schema.json's convention (independently authored, not $ref'd, per this package's own dedicated namespace).

rollback_operation_reference.description: Family-locked, per RAE-REQ-022: AG3 uses {job_id, original_commit_sha}; AG5 uses {per_id, ecp_id}. Neither shape is valid for the other site.
